tokens.title: Garden Tokens
tokens.intro: Every color, text style, radius, shadow, and motion token in the Word Garden design system, with English, Chinese, and Vietnamese test strings. Visible only with the garden flag on.

notes.swatch: The swatch uses the CSS variable; the hex beside it is copied from the spec. If they look different, the token is wrong.
notes.overline: Label style with the overline class. English is uppercase with letter spacing; Chinese keeps normal case and no spacing.
notes.motion: Hover or focus the tiles to see each duration. With reduced motion on, bloom drops to a 150ms fade and ambient loops stop.
notes.safeArea: This page's frame is padded by the safe-area insets and is at least 100dvh tall. On a Face ID iPhone the tinted strips show the notch and home-indicator insets.
notes.widths: Each bar is one GARDEN_CONTENT_WIDTH tier: full width on iPhone, capped on iPad.
notes.fonts: DM Sans (body) with Be Vietnam Pro for Vietnamese letters DM Sans lacks, and Fraunces with the optical-size axis (display). All three are self-hosted woff2 files, the same ones the canvas references were rendered with.

public.metaTitle: Dygo · Learn English words and actually know how to use them

hero.title: Learn a word. Use it right. Remember it forever.
hero.lead: Every word comes with real-world examples and clear explanations in your language. Dygo brings them back right before you forget them. All it takes is 5 minutes a day!
hero.languages: Available in English, Tiếng Việt, and 简体中文
hero.pill: Speaking practice with a native speaker

pains.title: Sound familiar?
pains.lead: Tap a card to see how Dygo makes learning effortless.
pains.hint: Tap to see how Dygo helps

use.front: “I know what it means, but I never know how to use it.”
use.back: Every word comes with real example sentences, synonyms, and fill-in-the-blank practice.

forget.front: “I learn a word today and completely forget it next week.”
forget.back: Dygo brings each word back right before you’re about to forget it.

language.back: Get meanings in Vietnamese or Chinese when you need them, and switch to English-only whenever you’re ready.

habit.front: “I start strong, but give up after three days.”
habit.back: Just 5 minutes and 3 quick missions a day. On crazy busy days, your rain barrel has your streak covered!

how.title: How your words grow
how.lead: Think of every word as a plant. Each time you review it and get it right, it grows stronger—and Dygo waits a little longer before the next watering.

seed.name: Seed
seed.means: A brand new word you’ve just added.
seed.grows: You study it for the first time.

sprout.name: Sprout
sprout.means: You’re still getting familiar with it.
sprout.reviews: Often, later that day or the next.
sprout.grows: You get it right a couple of times.

flower.name: Flower
flower.means: You've got a solid grip on it.
flower.reviews: Every few days, then every week or two.
flower.grows: You keep getting it right as review gaps stretch out.

fruiting.name: Fruiting
fruiting.grows: You keep getting it right. Most words reach this stage after 4 good reviews!

spread.title: Reviews spread out as your words grow
spread.text: Reviewing a word right before you forget it is the secret to making it stick. This way, your 5 minutes go toward the words that need it most.

drop.title: A water drop means it's due today
drop.text: Words with a water drop need reviewing today. Dygo curates them for you, so zero planning is required.

forgot.title: Forgot a word? No sweat!
forgot.text: It turns back into a sprout and pops up a few more times until it sticks for good.

uses.title: What do you need English for?
uses.lead: Grow the words that matter most to you.
uses.soonLine: In the meantime, start building your own word list!

work.name: Work & Business
work.line: Words for professional emails, meetings, and client chats.

study.name: Study & IELTS
study.line: The IELTS Academic word list is ready for you.

travel.name: Travel & Adventure
travel.line: Get around with total confidence on your next trip.

daily.name: Daily Life
daily.line: Everyday words for shopping, appointments, and casual conversations.

own.name: My Own Words
own.line: Save any word you encounter, along with your own definitions and examples.
own.lineAi: Add any word you encounter—Dygo automatically fills in definitions and examples!

features.title: Everything you need to expand your vocabulary

watering.title: Daily Watering
watering.text: Review the words due today. Tell Dygo how easily you remembered each one, and it'll schedule the perfect next review time.

quizzes.title: Fun Quizzes
quizzes.text: Pick the right word, match synonyms, fill in blanks, or listen and spell. Missed words loop back gently with zero harsh red X's!

beds.title: Topic Beds
beds.text: Curated IELTS Academic lists plus customizable beds you create yourself—complete with audio, examples, and synonyms.

missions.title: Missions & Golden Bloom
missions.text: Three quick daily missions. Complete them all to unlock a Golden Bloom, and rely on your rain barrel to protect your streak on crazy days.

shared.title: Shared Gardens
shared.text: Learn alongside friends or classmates. Track group momentum while keeping everyone's personal progress private.

language.title: In Your Language
language.text: Get clear meanings in Vietnamese or Chinese when you want extra support, or stick to English whenever you're ready.

parents.title: A special garden for kids, too!
parents.lead: Children can learn their very first English words with colorful visuals, sounds, and Dygo the bird! Features big buttons, bite-sized sessions, and bilingual prompts.

points.pictures: Picture quizzes: tap the word you hear
points.faces: Simple smiley faces instead of complicated ratings
points.stars: Cute bees and stars instead of scary red X's
points.account: Manage your child’s garden directly from your account

free.a: Yes! It's completely free to start, and no credit card is required.

who.a: Anyone looking to build vocabulary and speak English with confidence—whether for work, exams, travel, or everyday life!

english.q: Do I need to be advanced in English to start?
english.a: Not at all! Dygo provides clear explanations in Vietnamese or Chinese whenever you need them.

phone.q: Does it work on my phone?
phone.a: Yup! It works seamlessly in your browser across mobile, tablet, and desktop. You can even add it straight to your home screen just like an app!

time.q: How much time do I need each day?
time.a: Just about 5 minutes a day! Dygo handles the scheduling so you always know what needs watering.

ownWords.q: Can I add my own words?
ownWords.a: Absolutely! Add any word to “My Own Words” and review it just like any other plant.

kids.a: A specialized kids' garden is coming soon! Right now, Dygo is tailored for teens and adults.

speaking.q: How does speaking practice work? Is my voice kept?
speaking.a: Listen to a native speaker say a sentence with your word, then say it yourself. Dygo compares the two, shows the part that needs work and grows your word from seed to fruit. Your recording is checked, then deleted.

speak.title: Hear it. Say it. Watch it bloom.
speak.lead: Every word comes with a sentence read by a native speaker. Say it yourself, and Dygo puts your voice next to theirs so you can see what to fix.

listen.title: Listen
listen.text: Hear a native speaker say a real sentence with your word, in a UK or US accent.

say.title: Say it
say.text: Tap the mic and read the sentence aloud. No time limit, no pressure.

compare.title: Compare
compare.text: See your voice over theirs, the part that needs work, and how far your word has grown.

speak.privacy: Your recording is checked, then deleted.
